title: Continue your care
intro: Optional shortcuts after a visit. Kiorex sends nothing: these cards live only in your account.

rx.title: Send your prescription to a pharmacy
rx.body: Your prescription is in your records. Choose a pharmacy and place the order when you are ready.

lab.title: Book your lab test
lab.body: A lab test was ordered for you. Pick a lab and a collection time.

home.title: Book a home visit
home.body: Need a nurse or a home visit after your appointment? You can request one here.

consent.label: Keep my visit and this order connected
consent.help: Lets Kiorex count how care continues from a visit to a pharmacy, lab or home visit. It never shares what is in your prescription or tests, it never earns a reward and it never changes a price. Turn it off any time.

privacy: Cards only appear for your own account and only when the service is available.
